description: Set how the buyers of a company record read prices: net (VAT added on top) or gross (VAT inside); null falls back to the default, net for a company buyer. Applies to carts started after the change; existing carts and orders keep the mode they were priced in. Refused for a record that is not a company (a model with the Company capability). Returns the record id with its priceDisplayMode and taxRoundingMethod.

displayMode.description: net or gross; null falls back to the default, net for a company buyer

recordId.description: The company record's id (a record of a model with the Company capability; a customer's company.id)

name: set_company_price_display_mode
title: Set company price display mode
